solution.text:
All the three equations obtained are
cos⁡αx+sin⁡αz=0
y=1
sin⁡αx+cos⁡αz=0
So, the equations cos⁡αx+sin⁡αz=0 and sin⁡αx+cos⁡αz=0 has infinite solutions
Then, ∆=cos⁡αsin⁡αsin⁡αcos⁡α=0

⇒cos2⁡α-sin2⁡α=0⇒cos⁡2α=0
⇒α=π4,3π4,5π4,7π4
Sum of all values of α =4π

Hence, k=4
